//==
// # IField expression graphs
//
// Flat, index-based combinator graphs over scalar fields. Each node is one
// operation carrying exactly the operands it consumes: operand nodes referenced
// by index into the owning graph's node array (operands are always lower-indexed
// nodes), and externally supplied source fields referenced by index into a
// caller-maintained field list. The recursive evaluators live in
// `fields-graphs.library.plato`.

// A zero-based index of a node within a field expression graph's node array.
// Operands always reference lower-indexed nodes; -1 means "none".
type FieldNodeIndex
    implements IValue, IHashable, IComparable, IIndex
{
    Value: Integer;
}
